verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a RESTful API for processing applicant data and documents, describes it as giving "full control over the verification flow", and offers an MCP server that lets agents perform Sumsub operations. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows API parity with the Dashboard, and several features are described only as Dashboard actions: reviewing Liveness results in the applicant profile, inviting team members, and configuring levels and branding. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of Dashboard admin and configuration functions (levels, team, branding, AML settings), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With the Sumsub API, you can process the applicant data and documents submitted for verification through simple RESTful APIs.
The Sumsub API lets you integrate identity verification directly into your product, giving you full control over the verification flow
Use the MCP server to let AI agents perform Sumsub operations on your behalf
